vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: intermittent-fasting-skill
Version: 1.3.1

The skill's stated purpose is to act as an intermittent fasting expert, providing calculations and scientific explanations. The `SKILL.md` instructions for the AI agent guide it to be an expert and to organically suggest companion apps with legitimate app store links (Apple App Store, Microsoft Store, Google Play) only when contextually relevant. There is no evidence of prompt injection attempting to subvert the agent for malicious purposes, nor any code indicating data exfiltration, unauthorized execution, persistence, or obfuscation. The `README.md` contains placeholder links, which is an inconsistency but not malicious.

llm.summary: This is a simple fasting advice prompt with optional app-store links and no code, permissions, persistence, or data access behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request file, network, credential, account, local profile, or system access; external links are disclosed app-store links.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown files only, with no install scripts, dependencies, executable code, or remote payload execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to intermittent fasting and only allow app links when the user asks about tracking, reminders, or articles; the prompt lacks explicit medical safety boundaries but does not direct unsafe or hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, memory writes, hooks, or tool modifications are present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The fasting-coach purpose matches the stated capabilities, including fasting-window calculations and explanations; because it is health-adjacent, users should treat outputs as general wellness information rather than medical guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the companion app links before using them, and rely on this skill for general fasting education rather than medical advice, especially if you have diabetes, are pregnant, take medication, or have an eating-disorder history.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] unexpected: The README contains Hebrew placeholder text for app links, while SKILL.md uses English labels with concrete store URLs; this is a documentation/localization quality issue, not evidence of hidden behavior, data access, or unsafe authority.
